book.name: Yohane
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Yohane

content: Yecho na akalongo mundo
Pughajhomokila gheniya, Yecho atyangita kwenio ku Galilaya, akapahi jhe kujhenda ku Yudeya, nhwalo gwa bhakolo bha Akayahude bhapala kunkoma.
Unyagho ghumo gwa Akayahude ghunkemwa unyagho gwa Ichimba ukabhandikile.
Akalongo mundo Yecho bhajhakunnobholela, “Mmoke pamba na nnyende ku Yudeya, bhibhankengama bhakalolekeye mahengo ghimihenga.
Abhii jhe mundo jwaitenda ilebhe kwa kukihiya anda apala amanyikane pa bhando. Mwenga muhenga mahengo ghanga, mukilangiye palonge jha bhando bhoha!”
Helahela na akalongo mundo bhakannyeketile jhe.
Bhahe, Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Lichiko lyango lyamaha lyamela lyanahika jhe, nambo kwino mangota kila lichiko telatela.
Bhando bha nnema ghongo bhahoto jhe kunchimwa mangota, nambo nenga bhanjimwite nhwalo gwa kwalobholela ilebhe yubhatenda yambone jhe.
Mangota nnyendengane tugha kuunyagho gwenio. Nenga nijhenda jhe kuunyagho gwenio, nhwalo lichiko lyango lyambone lyamela.”
Alongila malobhe gheniya, peniya ajhakuhighalika koko ku Galilaya.
Yecho pa unyagho gwa ichimba
Akalongo mundo pubhajhahwila kuunyagho gwenio, na jwenio Yecho helahela ajhakujhenda kwenio, nambo akilangiya jhe hotuhotu nambo akajhahwi kwa kugwala.
Pa unyagho gwenio bhakolo bha Akayahude bhakibha bhampaliya Yecho, na bhajhakunkonya, “Bho, abhii kojhe mundo jhola?”
Kuhumi pa likunde lela pajhakubhehe mbwepombwepo yamahele panane jha Yecho. Na bhange bhalongila, “Ndi mundo jhonjo jwaumbone hake.” Na bhange bhalongila, “Nahijhe, jwenio abhahobhecha bhando.”
Nambo abhii jhe mundo jwakalongile hotuhotu panane jha Yecho, nhwalo bhajhogwipa bhakolo bha Akayahude.
Unyagho gwenio puheghelila kujhomokela, Yecho ajhakujhingila pa Nyumba jha Chapanga, na kutumbuu kubhola.
Bhahe, bhakolo bha Akayahude bhajhakukangacha na kulonge, “Bho, mundo jhonjo apatite koo mabholo ghanga na jwenio anabholwa jhe na mundo jhojhoha?”
Peniya Yecho ajhakujhanguu, “Mabholo ghinibhola ghango jhe, ghahuma kwa jhola jwandumita.
Mundo jwapala kuhenga ghala ghapala Chapanga, namanya ngita mabholo ghango ghihumi kwa Chapanga, amu nilonge kwa ukindendeke gwango namwete.
Jwenio jwabombolokana ipalaha kukikweya jwenio, nambo jwapalaha chipwa kwa jhola jwandumite, jwenio ndi jwantembekeya, na nkate jhake ubhii jhe uwange ghoghoha.
Bho, Mucha akapehi ndeka Lilaghalikilo? Pamonga na gheniya, abhii jhe hilu jhumo pakate jhino jwakamwile Lilaghalikilo. Kilebhe ghane chiumbala kungomela?”
Lilongo lya bhando bhajhakunyangula, “Mwenga ntehi kuchikilwa michuka! Ghane jwapala kunkoma mwenga?”
Yecho ajhakwajhanguu, “Nakatehi kikangacho chimo na mangota mikangacha.
Mucha akanaghalikiye majhingiye yana hino jando, pamo na Mucha amu akahoko bhino bhakatumbuliche lilaghalikilo lyenio, na mabhene kujhingii jando mwana Lichiko lya Kupomolela.
Bhahe, anda kujhingii jando mwana Lichiko lya Kupomolela lya Akayahude nhwalo gwa kulikamula lilaghalikilo lya Mucha kilebhe ghane chumbihikiya miho nduu, kunamicha mundo Lichiko lya Kupomolela?
Nkotoka kuhadabula kwa kunolekeya pamiho tugha, nambo ntende luhadabulo lwa mbone.”
Yecho Kilichitu ndi Nkomboche jwatumitwe na Chapanga
Bhahe, bhando bhange bha ku Yeluchalemo bhajhakutumbu kukikonya, “Bho, jhola mundo ilongoche jhubhapala kunkoma jhonjo jhe?
Dolokeya abhii pamba! Abhapwatalila pakongoloho, abhii jhe hilu mundo jwannobholela lilobhe. Bho, ilongoche bhito bhamanye kubhehe jhonjo ndi Kilichitu Nkomboche?
Nambo Kilichitu papala kuhika abhii jhe mundo jwapala kumanya nahumila kojhe, nambo twenga tumanya kwahumii mundo jhonjo.”

Bhahe, Yecho pabholita pa Nyumba jha Chapanga ajhakulonge kanonoha, “Bho, chakaka umanye na umanye kuhumile? Ihikite jhe kwa ukindendeke gwango namwete, nambo jhola jwandumita nenga ndi jwa chakaka. Mangota umanyi jhe,
nambo nenga nimanya nhwalo nihuma kwa jwenio, na jwenio ndi jwandumite.”
Peniya bhando bhajhakupala kunkamula, nambo abhii jhe mundo jwakatondobhiye lubhoko lwake kunkamula, nhwalo lichiko lyake likibha lyamela.
Nambo bhando bhamahele kubhoke palilongo lya bhando bhakanyeketile, bhalongila, “Kilichitu Nkomboche pahika, bho, natenda nginyililo kupeta yatehila mundo jhonjone?”
Akalonda bhitumwa kunkamula Yecho
Mapwalichayo bhajhakujhoha bhando bhakipwepa malobhe panane jha Yecho. Bhahe, akapiya Matambiko na Mapwalichayo bhajhakwatuma akalonda bha Nyumba jha Chapanga bhakapyeneneke Yecho.
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Natama na mangota kwa machiko ghandina tugha, peniya nanyenda kwa jhola jwandumita.
Naumbalaha, nambo naummona ndeka, nhwalo nauhoto jhe kuhika pala pumii nenga.”

Akakolo bha Akayahude bhalongila bhene kwa bhene, “Bho, mundo ojho najhenda kojhe ade natuhotola jhe kumona kabhele? Bho, najhenda kwa Akayahude bhubhapechingine pakate jha miche jha Akagilike, na kwabhola Akagilike?
Nhwalo gwa nike alongila, ‘Naumbalaha, nambo naumona ndeka, nhwalo nauhoto jhe kuhika pala pumii nenga?’”
Lukemba lwa mache lululeta ughome
Lichiko lya kujhomolela unyagho gwenio likibha lichiko likolongwa. Yecho ajhakujhema, ajhakulonge kwa lilobhe likolongwa, “Mundo jhojhoha jwabhii na nyota ahike kwa nenga anyweghe.
Ngita chighalonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga, ‘Mundo jhojhoha jwanyeketela nenga, ngemba ya mache ileta ughome naghakokola kuhumii nkate jhake.’ ”

Yecho palongila malobhe gha Uhuke gwa Chapanga, bhubhapala kumpokela bhando bhala bhubhannyeketile. Ade lichiko lyenio bhando bhakapokii jhe Uhuke gwa Chapanga. Nhwalo Yecho akibha amela analombwa jhe na Chapanga.
Kupechengana kwa bhando
Bhando bhange pakate jha lilongo lela bhakajhohine malobhe gheniya, bhajhakulonge, “Chakaka mundo jhonjo ndi jhola nnondole jwa Chapanga!”
Na bhange bhajhakulonge, “Jhojhone ndi Kilichitu Nkomboche!” Nambo na bhando bhange bhajhakukikonya, “Bho, Kilichitu Nkomboche ihoto kubhelukilwa ku Galilaya?
Bho, Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghakalongii jhe, Kilichitu nahumila kulukolo lwa munahota nkolongwa Daude, na nabhelukila ku muche gwa ku Betelehemo, kwatamita Daude!”
Bhahe, bhando bhajhakupechangana nhwalo gwa Yecho.
Bhando bhange bhapata kunkamula, nambo abhii jhe jwakajhighite kunkamula.
Ilongoche bha Kiyahude bhikana kunyeketela Yecho
Akalonda bha Nyumba jha Chapanga pibhakelehwika, akapiya Matambiko na Mapwalichayo bhajhakwakonya, “Bho, nhwalo gwa nike munkamwii jhe Yecho na kuhika nako pamba?”
Akalonda bhala bhajhakujhanguu, “Akibha jhe mundo jwahotwila kulonge kupeta mundo jhonjo!”
Bhahe, Mapwalichayo bhajhakwakonya, “Bho, na mangota helahela ankolwiye?”
“Bho, abhii kilongoche amu Pwalichayo jhumo jhumumwene anyeketile?
Nahijhe bhalimanyiti jhe Lilaghalikilo lya Mucha lilongo lene, nambo peniya alapanikiwe na Chapanga!”
Nikodemo, jhola jwannyendila Yecho, akibha jhumo jwa Mapwalichayo bhubhakibha peniya. Bhahe, ajhakwalobholela,
Lilaghalikilo lito lilongela, tuhoto ndeka kuhadabuu mundo jhojhoha anda na kunyokanikii jhe na kumanya alemwite nike.
Na bhene bhajhakunyangula, “Bho, na mwenga hele jwa koko ku Galilaya? Mukalingukiye Majhandiko gha Chapanga, naumanya abhii jhe nnondole jwa Chapanga jwahumii ku Galilaya.”
Bhahe, kila mundo ajhakujhenda kajhake.
